text:
Jordan: Quick async — planning a staged toggle for model v13 tonight. Target: EU + NA regions, start 1% -> 10% over 2 hours. Asking for ops sign-off and oncall aware. @Sarah @Mike
Sarah: SGTM. Need to confirm autoscaler headroom for eu-west-1 GPUs. Current headroom ~18%.
Mike: Will run a preflight check at 19:30 PT. Can someone list the flags/commands we'll use?
Jordan: Command we'll run:
```bash
rfd toggle set --flag model_v13_enable --percent 1 --regions eu-west-1,us-west-2 --meta "canary"
```
Lee: Can we add a KV-cache bypass for the canary to avoid poisoning hits? If yes, use `cache:skip=true` env on canary slice.
Sarah: On autoscaling: I bumped buffer to 25% in staging; prod looks ok but I'll monitor.
deploy-bot: [deploy queued] model-v13-canary -> slices: eu/na, percent=1
oncall: I'm oncall tonight. I'll watch SLO dashboards and pager if token-gen p95 > 200ms.
Jordan: Plan for roll forward: double percent every 30m if no regressions. Abort criteria: error rate >1%, p95 latency +20% baseline, or hallucination regression on the eval set.
Mike: Acked. I'll run the smoke script:
```bash
python infra/tools/smoke.py --target model_v13 --region eu-west-1 --requests 100
```
Sarah: Please post smoke results here. If all green, do 5% at +30m then 10% at +60m.
Jordan: Also note routing fallback: if capacity dips, we fallback to model_v12 automatically. Verified?
Lee: yes, tested in staging. fallback timeout 500ms.
Mike: Smoke done: 100 requests, 0 errors, median latency 88ms, p95=145ms. Posting logs: https://logs.redwood/example/abc123
Jordan: cool. I'll start the 1% toggle at 20:00 PT. @oncall stand by for the 20:05 check.
oncall: Standing by. Will update at 20:10 with SLO snapshot.
Sarah: One more: add a feature-flag tag `experiment:priority=low` so optimizer doesn't treat canary as prod cache.
Jordan: done. Starting now.
deploy-bot: [toggle applied] model_v13_enable percent=1 regions=[eu-west-1,us-west-2] by Jordan
oncall: 20:10 SLO snapshot: error_rate=0.3%, p95=150ms (+5%). No alerts.
Mike: moving to 5% in 30m unless we see issues. Will ping before.
Jordan: thanks all. If any anomalies react with :rotating_light: or call.
